Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About The Role
 In this role, you will work as a Full-stack Software Engineer on large-scale corporate information systems within a European public-sector environment, supporting grants, experts, and procurement management.
You will contribute to the development and modernization of the eExperts platform, building new features, enhancing existing functionality, improving technical components, and resolving production issues.
Working in an international, multicultural environment, you will develop secure, scalable applications across frontend and backend technologies, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and ensure high standards of software quality, security, and delivery.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain frontend and backend application components, including responsive user interfaces, business logic, APIs, and database interactions.
Build secure, scalable applications using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and modern frontend technologies.
Design, implement, secure, and document RESTful APIs and web services.
Apply security best practices for input validation, authentication, authorization, secure storage, logging, and monitoring.
Optimize application performance, usability, and compatibility across browsers and devices.
Develop and maintain integrations between frontend, backend, databases, and external systems.
Perform unit and integration testing, debugging, and production troubleshooting.
Deploy and maintain applications using AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Ensure code quality, maintainability, and compliance with technical standards.
Develop and maintain scalable software solutions using modern architectural patterns and development practices.
Analyze code, data, and processes to identify technical issues and improvement opportunities.
Maintain technical documentation and support continuous improvement of existing applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements.
Apply AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality and productivity while ensuring proper review of AI-generated code.
 Requirements
University degree corresponding to EQF Level 6 (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) and at least 12 years of professional IT experience.
Strong Java backend development expertise, including Java 19/21/25, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, and REST API development.
Knowledge of Spring Boot Actuator and Spring Boot Test.
Strong knowledge of Java EE/Jakarta EE technologies, including EJB 3, CDI, JMS, and WebLogic 14.
Experience with Maven, Hibernate JPA, and Liquibase.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Experience with frontend frameworks and libraries, including Angular, Vue, and Bootstrap.
Knowledge of frontend build tools and libraries such as Webpack, Vite, Nx, and RxJS.
Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB), including schema design and query optimization.
Knowledge of Elasticsearch and object-relational mapping technologies.
Proven experience designing, developing, and securing RESTful APIs and web services, including OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
Good understanding of authentication and authorization standards, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
Experience with Apache Kafka and knowledge of integration technologies such as JAX-WS, JAXB, and Protobuf.
Knowledge of workflow engines such as Camunda and Activiti, including BPMN 2.
Strong experience with AWS cloud services and deploying and managing applications in cloud environments.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Container as a Service (CaaS).
Knowledge of Consul for service discovery and configuration, and AWS Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.
Experience with Git workflows, including GitFlow and trunk-based development, GitLab, and Bitbucket, with an understanding of SVN.
Experience with architectural patterns, including hexagonal architecture, microservices, and CQRS.
Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools, including Kibana, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Micrometer, and distributed tracing.
Experience with unit and integration testing using JUnit 4/5, Mockito, Vitest, and Playwright.
Experience with large-scale Agile development practices and Jira for backlog and task management.
Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools such as Amazon Q and Kiro, including reviewing and maintaining AI-generated code.
Ability to integrate frontend and backend builds into CI/CD pipelines.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to apply software development, security, cloud, and quality best practices.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
Strong communication skills, including presenting technical findings, documenting solutions, and aligning multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies, assignments, and changing priorities.
Proactive, results-oriented approach with strong prioritization skills and a commitment to continuous improvement.
English or French proficiency at B2 level or higher, both spoken and written.
 Nice to Have
Experience developing or maintaining public-sector information systems.
Knowledge of grant management, expert management, or procurement-related platforms.
Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer, Jakarta EE Application Developer, or Spring Professional Certification.
AWS Certified Developer – Associate or equivalent certification.
 SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer.
